526:t_1:4.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「You're $$ギャビン・ハンター$$ of $$ミスリル$$?」

526:t_1:5.en:
$$ハンター$$
「There's no point denying it...」

526:t_1:6.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「Don't think you can escape. Four AS units have surrounded you and your transport trailer.」

526:t_1:7.en:
$$ハンター$$
「I know that without being told.」

526:t_1:8.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「We've already inspected the cargo. Now we'll await $$ミスタ・Ｋ（カリウム）$$'s decision.」

526:t_1:9.en:
$$ハンター$$
($$ミスタ・Ｋ$$... I hear $$アマルガム$$'s executives have code names based on chemical symbols...)

526:t_1:10.en:
$$ハンター$$
(So one of them is coming here...)

526:t_1:12.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「No, sir... Once we tracked them down, it was an easy mission.」

526:t_1:15.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「It's been a while, $$ハンター$$.」

526:t_1:16.en:
$$ハンター$$
「Mister $$カリーニン$$! Why are you with $$アマルガム$$!?」

526:t_1:17.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「It happens often in the mercenary world.」

526:t_1:18.en:
$$ハンター$$
「I heard you went missing in the battle at $$メリダ島$$...」

526:t_1:21.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「ARX-8... Completing a successor to the $$ＡＲＸ－７　アーバレスト$$ under these circumstances is commendable.」

526:t_1:22.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「But building something like that won't change anything. It's wasted effort.」

526:t_1:23.en:
$$ハンター$$
「Mister $$カリーニン$$... I never thought I'd hear you say that.」

526:t_1:24.en:
$$ハンター$$
「Wasn't that why those wonderful young people aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ trusted you?」

526:t_1:26.en:
$$ハンター$$
「So many of our comrades were killed! And of all things, you do this... How shameless you are...! Doesn't it hurt you at all!?」

526:t_1:28.en:
$$ハンター$$
「Wait, Mister $$カリーニン$$! Are you really...」

526:t_1:31.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「That was a warning shot. ...Now, answer my questions.」

526:t_1:32.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Who assembled that machine, the ARX-8? And where are they?」

526:t_1:34.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You don't intend to answer?」

526:t_1:36.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I shot a place that won't kill you instantly. Do you feel like talking now?」

526:t_1:38.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I see... Then enjoy the time you have left before you die.」

526:t_1:40.en:
$$ハンター$$
(So $c must now face an enemy so formidable that AS units equipped with $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ pale in comparison...)

526:t_1:45.en:
$$レナード$$
「...I hear part of $c has descended to this Earth.」

526:t_1:46.en:
$$ファウラー$$
「We've received intelligence from the Empire that a unit believed to be them is operating on the eastern Pacific front.」

526:t_1:47.en:
$$レナード$$
「There's no need to check. It'll be $$テレサ$$ and the others.」

526:t_1:48.en:
$$レナード$$
「Knowing them, I think they've split their forces into several groups to disrupt the Empire on multiple fronts.」

526:t_1:49.en:
$$レナード$$
「And $$テレサ$$ will certainly come after me.」

526:t_1:50.en:
$$ファウラー$$
「It's exactly as you surmised.」

526:t_1:51.en:
$$レナード$$
「Honestly... I'm constantly astonished by that girl's inability to accept defeat.」

526:t_1:52.en:
$$レナード$$
「She was somewhat better in $$ミスリル$$, but since joining $c, she's done nothing but make foolish choices...」

526:t_1:53.en:
$$レナード$$
「That makes her no different from those coarse, vulgar dreamers who act on emotion.」

526:t_1:54.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「Also, $$ミスタ・Ｋ$$ reports that he's captured the machine in question.」

526:t_1:55.en:
$$レナード$$
「ARX-8... I'm interested in it.」

526:t_1:56.en:
$$レナード$$
「After all, it's their last trump card.」

526:t_1:57.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「I understand. I'll arrange to have it transported here immediately.」

526:t_1:58.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$ファウラー$$, track $$テレサ$$ and the others' movements.」

526:t_1:59.en:
$$ファウラー$$
「What should we do if they head this way?」

526:t_1:60.en:
$$レナード$$
「If they wish to meet me, perhaps I'll oblige.」

526:t_1:62.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「Then we'll take our leave.」

526:t_1:63.en:
$$レナード$$
「Once $$カスパー$$'s report arrives, our preparations will be complete...」

526:t_1:64.en:
$$レナード$$
「...So, are you concerned enough about them to want to eavesdrop?」

526:t_1:66.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's been a while since I've seen life in your eyes.」

526:t_1:67.en:
$$かなめ$$
($$ミスリル$$ and $c are still alive... I'm sure he is, too...)

526:t_1:68.en:
$$かなめ$$
(And he's looking for me... just to take me back to that town... that school...)

526:t_1:69.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Even though I went with another man, all but betraying him...)

526:t_1:70.en:
$$かなめ$$
(What am I doing compared to that...? I think growing old and dying in this boring mansion, doing nothing, will somehow atone for it...)

526:t_1:71.en:
$$かなめ$$
(But... I want to see him... I want to see $$宗介$$...)

526:t_1:72.en:
$$レナード$$
「Is there anything you want? You seem thoroughly fed up with this boring life.」

526:t_1:74.en:
$$レナード$$
「I don't mind that much. I'll have to disable its communication functions, though.」

526:t_1:76.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I'll find what I can do... Then I'll do it... I'll go faster and stronger, always forward.)

526:t_1:77.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I'll charge ahead like that idiot, in my own way...)

526:t_1:81.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Run, run, run! A warrior who can't run will never win!」

526:t_1:84.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「All those operations in space have weakened your muscles and field instincts! I'm going to retrain you from the ground up here!」

526:t_1:87.en:
$$カレン$$
「Have they been like that all morning?」

526:t_1:88.en:
$$アルト$$
「They didn't start this morning... They've been at it nonstop since the middle of the night.」
